meta.purpose: Store-link tap counts in human sessions without the one session that tapped a store link on /privacy (8 taps in 3 s on the phone menu's 'Pre-order Kheelu' button, 2026-09-20, before cta tags went live; see H14e-H14g in 2026-10-11-human-session-recomputes.json). Also one read-only check of the saved baseline funnel's test-account setting after D031.
meta.human_filter: properties.$session_id IN the audit's Q34 per-session subquery (>=1 $pageview, no $virt_is_bot event, entry referrer not localhost:3456 / 127.0.0.1:3456 / *.vercel.app), as in 2026-10-11-human-session-recomputes.json
meta.caveat: Aggregates only; no person-level data. The insight read keeps only the query-definition fields that bear on the check; creator and editor fields are left out.

queries.what: Store-link taps from kheelona.com per device, human sessions, excluding every session with a store-link tap on /privacy (taps, untagged, fixed-element and guide-bar taps, each with sessions)
queries.hogql: SELECT properties.$device_type AS device, count() AS taps, uniq(properties.$session_id) AS sessions, countIf(coalesce(properties.cta,'') = '') AS untagged_taps, uniqIf(properties.$session_id, coalesce(properties.cta,'') = '') AS untagged_sessions, countIf(position(elements_chain, 'fixed') > 0) AS fixed_taps, uniqIf(properties.$session_id, position(elements_chain, 'fixed') > 0) AS fixed_sessions, countIf(position(elements_chain, 'md:hidden') > 0 AND position(elements_chain, 'fixed') > 0) AS guide_bar_taps, uniqIf(properties.$session_id, position(elements_chain, 'md:hidden') > 0 AND position(elements_chain, 'fixed') > 0) AS guide_bar_sessions, (SELECT uniq(properties.$session_id) FROM events WHERE event = '$autocapture' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname = '/privacy' AND elements_chain_href LIKE '%store.kheelona.com%') AS excluded_sessions FROM events WHERE event = '$autocapture' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND elements_chain_href LIKE '%store.kheelona.com%' AND properties.$session_id IN (SELECT sid FROM (SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot, countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pvs FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$pageview','preorder_form_started','preorder_start','begin_checkout','purchase') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING pvs > 0 AND is_bot = 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app'))) AND properties.$session_id NOT IN (SELECT properties.$session_id FROM events WHERE event = '$autocapture' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND properties.$host = 'kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname = '/privacy' AND elements_chain_href LIKE '%store.kheelona.com%') GROUP BY device ORDER BY device
queries.note: excluded_sessions is the number of sessions removed (1, a phone session; it is the same in both rows because it is a scalar subquery). Phone with that session (H14, H14d): 29 taps / 18 sessions, untagged 25 / 15, fixed 22 / 12. Without it: 21 / 17, untagged 17 / 14, fixed 14 / 11, and every remaining fixed-element tap is the guide's bar. Laptop is unchanged.
